description: Deep in-the-money American put price strictly exceeds the European binomial put price when r > 0.

import MathFin.Binomial.AmericanPutEarlyExercisePremium

open MathFin

/-- Deep in-the-money American put price strictly exceeds the European binomial put price when r > 0. -/
theorem mf_binomial_put_early_exercise_premium {u d r K S : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (h : BinomialNoArb u d r)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hK : 0 < K) (hS : 0 < S) (hdeep : S * u ^ n ≤ K) :
    binomialPrice u d r (fun S' => max (K - S') 0) n S <
      americanPrice u d r (fun S' => max (K - S') 0) n S :=
  MathFin.binomialPrice_lt_americanPrice_put_deep_itm hn h hr hK hS hdeep
